evidence.V1: Front outline is a clean circle with 8 evenly spaced rivets; the three-quarter view and silhouette read as a round shield. The top view shows the rim, boss dome and handle profile. A15 X/Z error is 0.0, and the boss is centred and seated.
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: big gold rim and disc, then the boss dome with a dark collar and the concentric teal/cream rings, then small rivets.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: a thick chunky rim, an oversized domed boss and a slightly dished face. These are not stiff primitives.
evidence.V4: Rim has consistent chamfers whose highlight band catches the light. The boss collar and dome edges are softened, and rivets are rounded.
evidence.V5: The boss close-up is clean, but the rim close-up shows visible segment faceting along the outer rim bevel highlight, and the rivets are low-poly and faceted at close range (minor).
evidence.V6: Disciplined: gold accent rim, warm cream, steel greys for the boss and rivets, and one hue (teal) for the rings with a darker steel collar for value contrast. Colourways swap only the hue.
evidence.V7: 2480 tris against the weapon target of 2500 (ceiling 4000), so at or under target.
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material with vertex colours, kit palette (gold, cream, steel, one hue), chamfered edges and smooth shading. It matches the kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line is correct: origin at the handle centre, CollisionFidelity Box, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.
